name: Gonka24
description: Broker front-end for Gonka inference with $1 of credit after verification.
overview: Gonka24 is an independent broker for Gonka-network inference, exposing Kimi K2.6, MiniMax M2.7, DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash at router.gonka24-style prices through api.gonka24.com/v1. New accounts get $1 of free credit after email and a human check, with no card required to start, and the dashboard tracks requests, token volume and balance. At its listed rates that $1 buys roughly 70 million GLM-5.3-Flash input tokens, so it is a small but usable test budget.
free_access: $1 free credit after email and human verification
Usage and balance visible in the dashboard
notes: Smallest grant in the Gonka family, kept because the per-token rates are low enough that $1 still buys tens of millions of tokens. Independent broker, not affiliated with the network itself.
